results.reasoning: Judged on a scratch copy (sit-cna) served at :4793 so every refusal fired at a disposable ledger, with only this verdict landing in the real one. I drove the live panel to rule panel.rules.detail-slide on the Rules tab, opened its addressed note n-0043, and tried to make it accept: Verify with the identity emptied and again with the name agent both recorded nothing - the panel said Verify and waive are recorded under a person's name, set it in Settings first, and opened Settings on the Record as field, which is the ask for a person's name the rule requires; the thread file's sha256 was byte-identical after every attempt and the panel issued zero write requests to /api/threads (probe JSON). Under a person-shaped name with the composer empty, Waive and Reopen were each refused until a reason is written, and the thread stayed addressed on screen and on disk. I also went around the buttons: POST /api/threads/n-0043/status with verified-as-agent, verified-with-no-actor, waive-without-reason and reopen-without-reason all came back 400 carrying the governance error, disk still unchanged, so the refusal is the serve's and not only the button's. Driven with a throwaway Playwright script against my own serve because the built-in browser pane could not composite screenshots this session; the script was the driving itself, not a re-enactment, and the PNGs and probe JSON it saved are what I judged from. Both declared surfaces are captured at 1280x900 for the record, but the behavioural judgment is against the live panel, since the stand-in app surface is the design served statically and cannot refuse anything.
